goal: Make Harness v0.6 select verification by runtime risk, remove duplicate CI work, and separate merge readiness from archive closure.
userValue: Routine fixes and releases progress quickly without weakening candidate deployment, fail-closed runtime behavior, or truthful live evidence.
nonGoals: No backend, API, PG read-model, mini-program, deployment or production-data behavior changes.
No removal of candidate deployment or scoped live smoke for runtime-sensitive changes.
No lane registry, resource lease platform, dependency install or third-party download.

evidenceRequired: focused project-harness, project-state and verify-project tests
workflow assertion that CI invokes full exactly once

engineeringHealth.reason: The change narrows docs/tooling orchestration only and leaves all runtime release behavior untouched.

acceptanceEvidence: node --test tests/project-harness.test.js tests/project-owner-map.test.js tests/project-state.test.js tests/backend-owner-map.test.js tests/verify-project.test.js

decisionLog.decision: User approved the balanced B approach: retain runtime candidate proof while removing duplicate verification, intermediate candidates and archive-as-merge-gate behavior.
